name: week
title: Workspace review desk
subtitle: Imported evidence only. Review findings before changing Microsoft 365.

sections.title: Current inventory
sections.sql: select tenant,external_id,name,service,owner_name,source_on from workspace_inventory order by tenant,external_id

sections.title: Review findings
sections.sql: select tenant,external_id,name,rule,finding from governance_findings order by tenant,external_id,rule

sections.title: Overdue reviews
sections.sql: select external_id,name,kind,reviewer,due_on,current_snapshot from review_register where overdue order by due_on

sections.title: External and unknown sharing
sections.sql: select tenant,external_id,name,sharing,sensitivity,legal_hold from workspace_inventory where sharing<>'internal' order by tenant,external_id

sections.title: Retention review
sections.sql: select tenant,external_id,name,retention_review_on,legal_hold from workspace_inventory where retention_review_on is null or retention_review_on<=current_date order by tenant,external_id
